verdict.rationale: Manufact offers a few fixed, event-driven automations that run without user action: pushing to the production branch auto-triggers a deployment, a publish checklist can start automatically after each successful deploy, and branch triggers are configurable. API keys also allow CI and script access. These are built-in deployment hooks, not general user-defined background automations. Missing for 10: user-configurable automations or workflows, scheduled/cron or background jobs, autonomous agent runs beyond deploy and checklist triggers, and independent corroboration.
